mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_random_box_tbl ( user_id, issue_reason, source_id, target_account_id, box_status, reward_point, issued_at, opened_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{issueReason}, #{sourceId}, #{targetAccountId}, #{boxStatus}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT user_random_box_id, user_id, issue_reason, source_id, target_account_id, box_status, reward_point, DATE_FORMAT( issued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS issued_at, CASE WHEN opened_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT( opened_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) END AS opened_at FROM user_random_box_tbl WHERE user_random_box_id = #{userRandomBoxId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_random_box_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND issue_reason = #{issueReason} AND issued_at >= CURDATE() AND issued_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT user_random_box_id, user_id, issue_reason, source_id, target_account_id, box_status, reward_point, DATE_FORMAT( issued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS issued_at, CASE WHEN opened_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT( opened_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) END AS opened_at FROM user_random_box_tbl WHERE user_random_box_id = #{userRandomBoxId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_random_box_tbl SET box_status = 'OPENED', reward_point = #{rewardPoint}, opened_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_random_box_id = #{userRandomBoxId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND box_status = 'UNOPENED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_random_box_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND box_status = 'UNOPENED'

SELECT user_random_box_id, user_id, issue_reason, source_id, target_account_id, box_status, reward_point, DATE_FORMAT( issued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS issued_at, CASE WHEN opened_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT( opened_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) END AS opened_at FROM user_random_box_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND box_status = 'UNOPENED' ORDER BY issued_at ASC, user_random_box_id ASC
